input_types: UTF-8 JSON stdin object with exactly a public query string (1-512 characters, at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes) and integer max_results (1-10)
required_outputs: At most ten Crossref Works metadata rows with DOI when present, title, issued publication year when present, type, publisher, container title, up to ten author names with count/truncation, and provider-reported cited-by count; abstracts, references, links, and URLs are omitted.
Provider hit count, retrieval timestamp, response bytes, query/request/response/source-code SHA-256 values, HTTP/acquisition outcome, selected public-pool rate headers, and bounded claim ceiling.
route_preconditions: Local source navigation and the declared source-cluster brief do not already satisfy the task.
The caller explicitly selects the Crossref candidate and separately approves sending this public non-sensitive query.
The task needs Crossref Works DOI and deposited metadata discovery, not exact DOI verification or exhaustive review.
The caller coordinates public-pool rate and concurrency at one list-query request per second and one concurrent request.
authority_boundary: Route selection only proposes a tool. Actual execution still requires --allow-public-network and task-specific caller authorization; no permission or external-action authority is granted.
